assumptions: BOOKING CHECKLIST: Ikos Aria: which wedding costs sit inside the all-inclusive stay and which are charged on top; ceremony spots; guest numbers beyond the 30 accommodated; reception options.

facts.claim: Ikos Aria on Kos hosts weddings: its wedding page says the resort's event planner team and a devoted wedding planner plan and coordinate the event, from coordinating the legal arrangements with the local Town Hall to arranging accommodation for up to 30 guests, and couples can choose from packages featuring touches from wedding cakes to romantic dinners.

Ikos Aria's Special Wedding package lists: reservation of the wedding venue date and time; wedding planning and coordination; assistance in submitting the documents for a civil wedding; help to receive the marriage certificate after the civil wedding; a wedding cake to serve 10 people; rose petals in the room on the wedding day. Couples staying for their honeymoon also receive a romantic dinner, a farewell gift and a welcome bottle of sparkling wine.

Ikos Aria's wedding page says vows can be read in designated wedding spots in the resort grounds; a legal ceremony needs officially translated legal documents and two witnesses of legal age, and couples should contact the Greek consulate in their home country about paperwork, as the Greek government sets the requirements.

The Ikos Resorts site describes its Greek resorts, including Ikos Aria on Kos, as stays where 'everything is included in your stay' (the resort's all-inclusive holiday concept); the wedding page does not state that the wedding package itself is all inclusive.
